entries.zh: 祈杯（掷杯珓祈问神明——于神像前掷筊卜问吉凶）
entries.en: to cast lots with divination blocks before an idol; to seek an oracle by throwing the crescent blocks
entries.notes: 西语栏中段残缺（con cañizo del [残] el ydolo），掷杯问卜义据汉字栏“祈杯”与闽音栏拟定，且“桮/杯”用字存疑。

entries.zh: 灵杯（掷灵杯问神——杯珓显灵应之卜，神前掷杯求神明回应）
entries.en: to cast lots before an idol; spirit-lot divination, the block throw that gives the spirit's answer

entries.zh: 灵位（安设亡者灵位牌位，供亡魂凭依受祭）
entries.en: to set up the spirit tablet of the dead; the memorial tablet where the deceased's soul receives offerings
entries.notes: 西语栏多处残断（poner la … del muerto … como anima），安设亡者牌位义据汉字栏“灵位”与闽音栏拟定。

entries.zh: 抽签（抽取签支卜问吉凶）
entries.en: to draw divination lots (bamboo fortune sticks); to cast lots

entries.zh: 起卦（起卦占卜——掷骰布卦以断吉凶）
entries.en: to cast a divination hexagram; to divine by dice or lots

entries.zh: 阴杯（掷杯珓得阴杯——两珓皆覆之凶兆否答，示神不许）
entries.en: yin cup; the inauspicious throw in block divination (both blocks face down, a negative answer); to cast lots

entries.zh: 求签（神前求签问卜）
entries.en: to seek an oracle by drawing fortune sticks; to cast lots

entries.zh: 拾问分（拈阄问分——抽签定份额所归）
entries.en: to cast lots for whoever it falls to; to allot shares by lot
entries.notes: 闽音栏前两音节污损难辨（T99），拈阄问分义据西语栏 hechar suerte a quien le cabe 与汉字栏拟定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅汉字栏存“拾问”，西语、闽音、官话三栏皆空白；参照本页第 8 条“拾问分”疑亦拈阄义，暂不立释。

entries.zh: 糟蹋毁弃（抛掷毁坏、糟蹋浪费；汉字栏“打劫介”用字存疑）
entries.en: to spoil, to ruin, to waste; to throw to destruction
entries.notes: 汉字“劫/怯”“介/个”两处异文，释义以西语栏 echar a perder（毁坏糟蹋）为主轴拟定。

entries.zh: 诬赖（无端诬指，嫁罪于人）
entries.en: to accuse falsely, to impute blame groundlessly; to lay the blame on someone
entries.notes: 闽音栏第二音节污损难辨（T99），诬赖义据汉字栏与西语归咎框架拟定。

entries.zh: 相骂（对骂，互相斥责诟骂）
entries.en: to revile each other, to quarrel with abusive words

entries.zh: 牵连（牵连连累，拖人入罪）
entries.en: to implicate, to involve another in one's guilt

entries.zh: 推度伊（猜度他——疑心推测而归咎于他）
entries.en: to suspect him; to cast suspicion and blame upon him

entries.zh: 移祸（移祸于人——转嫁灾殃罪责）
entries.en: to shift calamity or blame onto another

entries.zh: 牵带（牵扯带累他人入事入罪）
entries.en: to drag another in; to involve him in guilt or trouble

entries.zh: 生入人罪（把罪名栽入人身——构陷加罪于人）
entries.en: to impute guilt to someone; to frame another with a crime
entries.notes: 闽音栏三处音节污损难辨（T99），加罪于人之义据汉字栏“生入人罪”拟定。

entries.zh: 革客（革退客商——逐客商离船、辞退客商）
entries.en: to dismiss the merchants; to put the traders off the ship

entries.zh: 革去（革除黜退——罢免除去，使去职离位）
entries.en: to dismiss, to remove from office; to put apart

entries.zh: 革除（革除驱逐——扔掷逐出、摒除斥革）
entries.en: to expel, to cast out; to throw away hurling
entries.notes: 闽音栏内残留未配汉字的西语词 arrojando，释义以西语栏与汉字栏“革除”互证拟定。

entries.zh: 刈舍（割舍抛舍——弃绝恶人恶事，甩脱恶者）
entries.en: to cast away from oneself the wicked or evil; to cut off and discard

entries.zh: 诅骂（诅咒辱骂，以恶言咒詈于人）
entries.en: to curse; to revile with abusive language
